Subject: Mini preflight: SOC 2 + pen test quick sync

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call last week. Devlin mentioned you wanted to run a short preflight before we schedule the full SOC 2 walkthrough and the pen-test kickoff. To keep this low-friction, would FinWise be open to a 30-minute "preflight" to: 
- validate the attendee list for the SOC2 intake (who will own evidence)
- confirm scope for the pen vendor (surface areas, exclude list)
- confirm DPA clause and any data retention carve-outs we should surface ahead of the main review

Proposed slots (PT): Thu 11/26 17:00-17:30, Fri 11/27 08:30-09:00, Mon 11/30 09:00-09:30. If none work, share two 30-min windows and we’ll adapt.

I attached a short checklist we’ll use to triage evidence so the SOC2 folks aren’t caught off-guard. Laura (CS) and Jonas (SE) are on CC to handle evidence routing and the technical scope respectively.

Thanks —
Ben

Thanks for running point, Ben —

Quick update after our preflight: the 30-min slot was tight but productive. Notes for the thread: 
- Evidence owners: we assigned IAM logs to DevOps (Name: Mariana), API access logs to Platform (Name: Kyle), and data retention contact to Legal (Name: Priya).
- Pen scope: FinWise will exclude customer PII sample data and agreed to provide sanitized examples instead; Redwood to confirm the vendor-side handling in writing.
- DPA: we confirmed the standard SFTP retention clause may need a minor carve-out for audit logs; Aisha asked for the annotated DPA extracts — Ben / Laura, can you upload the annotated extracts with reference line numbers?
- Next steps: schedule full SOC2 walkthrough (1 hour) w/ evidence handoff; suggested week-of Dec 7 (options noted in the shared Drive doc).

Thanks all — I’ll post the meeting notes to the Drive and include links in our procurement ticket.

—Devlin
